items.title: Lovie Austin Interview, 1969-04-25
items.q: Sidney used to work with us when I was Mac Devon.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, I know. I think I know now. Woodward. I know the band. I know who you mean. Well, that's what he said. I think Sidney Bechet was with him maybe for a while too. Yes, Sidney.
Sidney used to work with us when I was Mac Devon.
